title: Caras Park
specs: Public park with year-round access and multiple event hosting
Multiple power sources (110v and 220v) for food trucks and caterers
Permanent restrooms open mid-April to mid-October
General liability insurance with minimum $2,000,000 coverage listing Missoula Downtown Association as additional insured
includes: 35 rectangular tables (8-foot) and 125 beige metal folding chairs
15 large picnic tables in the park
Garbage and recycling receptacles and plastic liners
One on-site facilities manager for setup and teardown
gap: Exact hours of availability beyond 6 am to 11 pm not stated
blurb: Caras Park is a versatile public park used year-round and hosts 80-100 events annually. It can be rented for events with capacities up to 4,000 people, including banquet-style events under the pavilion for 250-350 guests. The park includes amenities such as tables, chairs, power sources, restrooms (seasonal), and playground access.
extraNote: $200 non-refundable deposit required to confirm booking, counts toward total fee · $350 security deposit required, refundable if park left in good condition; card on file option available · All fees and deposits due 30 days before event · Amplified sound must end by 10 pm Sunday-Thursday and 10:30 pm Friday-Saturday · Contact Downtown Missoula Partnership to schedule a tour or rental inquiry. · Year-round utilization; restrooms open mid-April to mid-October
